title: Gemini API File Search is now multimodal
summary: Google's Gemini API now supports multimodal file search capabilities, enabling developers to search across multiple file types including text, images, and documents in a unified manner. This expansion enhances Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications by allowing AI systems to understand and retrieve information from diverse file formats.
problem_solved: Enables developers to build AI applications that can search and understand content across different file formats, solving the limitation of single-modality document search in RAG systems.
why_valuable: This feature significantly improves the capability of AI applications to process and retrieve information from heterogeneous document sources, making RAG systems more powerful and versatile for enterprise use cases.
